answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the haven graph and each risks its bond. Because the marble release is recorded with every signature, the delta audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 3 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Each copy needs 4 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
